tip: Anchor tall furniture to the wall – children love to climb drawers.
Keep blind and curtain cords out of reach or choose cordless blinds.
Rotate toys every few weeks – fewer toys out means more focused play.
A cool bedroom (about 18–20 °C) helps children sleep better.
Put picture labels on toy boxes so little ones can tidy up themselves.
Low open shelves let children choose and put away toys independently.
Air the room every day – fresh air is good for sleep and concentration.
Calm base colours on the walls and bright accents in textiles are easy to update.
Place the bed away from the window and radiator.
The upper bunk is generally not recommended for children under 6.
